_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Flat leg, momentum ~48, near-zero funding and no range break leave the coil intact; HOLD is the base-rate call until a named breaker prints.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency coil; narrative silent on phase but inflow print supports staying cautious, not adding risk
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains range-bound with funding near flat and momentum stuck ~40-60
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum through ~70 with funding heating (up toward Disbelief) or F&G under ~45 with CVD rollover and vol expansion (down toward Anxiety)
